episode_summary: In this episode, Bobby Kerr discusses the critical role of Google Business Profile optimization for real estate agents. He emphasizes the importance of hyper-local content and detailed client reviews to enhance online visibility and leverage AI in real estate searches. Bobby provides actionable strategies for agents to stand out in local search results and improve client engagement.
